plugins.name: rig
plugins.description: rig — a LEGO-style harness composer. Compose bricks (facets/patterns/steps/recipes) at invocation time into a task-specific agent harness for dev-flow orchestration (review, implement, PR, and more). Claude Code native; no heavy DSL engine.

plugins.name: claude-context-checker
plugins.description: Status line and hooks for tracking Claude Code's context window usage: adaptive thresholds that follow the auto-compact point, a subagent status line showing per-agent context %, and pre-compact checkpoints.
